## Metric definitions

Canonical Unicode composition; en-US POSIX lowercase; remove Unicode punctuation and symbols; split on Unicode whitespace. No number expansion, accent folding or filler removal. Empty-reference WER is undefined.

Wall seconds from per-file setup (including file opening, module/analyzer creation, lazy model loading, decode/conversion and analysis) through finalization and draining the final-result stream. Asset setup/download excluded. Files are processed as fast as possible, without real-time pacing.

Time-to-final is file-processing completion latency, not latency after a live speaker releases the record button. RTF below 1 means faster than audio duration. Corpus WER and RTF use sums, not averages of clip ratios. WER may exceed 100%. Undefined/unavailable values display as N/A and are omitted from JSON. Each clip gets a new analyzer with default model retention; OS caches may affect later clips. These Mac timings do not establish iPhone 14 Pro performance.
